title: Test BackupService batch operations
description: Unit-test BackupService (src/services/instantdb/backup-service.ts) by mocking the InstantDB client at the module level. The critical paths are: batch-delete respects the 25-item limit, city ID remapping produces the correct old→new map, and restoreMaps skips maps whose city_id has no entry in cityIdMap.
steps: Add '__mocks__/db.js' or configure jest moduleNameMapper to stub '@/lib/db' if not already done
Mock '@/lib/db' with jest.mock: stub queryOnce and transact; stub db.tx.maps and db.tx.cities with chainable .delete()/.update()/.link() spies
Mock '@instantdb/react-native' id() to return predictable values (counter or fixed UUIDs)
Write tests for fetchBackupData: maps raw DB rows to BackupData shape; sets version '1.0'
Write tests for deleteAllMaps: empty result → no transact call; 30 maps → transact called twice (batches of 25 + 5); progress callback receives correct (done, total) values
Write tests for deleteAllCities: same batch logic without progress callback
Write tests for restoreCities: returns cityIdMap with old→new entries; calls transact with correct city name and congregation link
Write tests for restoreMaps: maps with valid city_id are included; maps with unknown city_id are skipped; progress callback fires per batch
tests: fetchBackupData maps cities to { id, name }
fetchBackupData maps maps to correct shape including null fallbacks
deleteAllMaps: no transact call when maps array is empty
deleteAllMaps: progress callback called with (25, 30) then (30, 30)
restoreCities: returned map has one entry per city (oldId → newId)
restoreCities: each city transaction links to congregationId
restoreMaps: maps without a matching cityIdMap entry are skipped
restoreMaps: progress callback fires per batch
restoreMaps: new IDs are generated for every restored map
acceptanceCriteria: All tests pass with bun test
db module mock does not bleed into other test files (scoped or reset in afterEach)
